description:
"Etch a blasphemous rune on your enemy's mind, charming them after a |cffffff1|r second delay for |cffffff4|r seconds. This eldritch attraction causes them to move towards the player and applies Minor Vulnerability for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r%.

If used against a monster, the charm lasts for |cffffff8|r seconds.

This ability cannot be dodged."
